parent_objective: design reset/static preflight mapping from M2455 protocol artifacts before any reset or execution
blocked_by: M2455 protocol rows are not executable scenario specs
reset/static preflight mapping must be designed before any reset or rollout
labels and hidden metadata must remain actor-input blocked
supersedes: direct reset/static preflight without a mapping design
direct measured rollout from M2455 protocol rows
direct scenario redesign execution, repair, or training

public_gates: M2457 must design reset/static preflight mapping only and must not execute reset, rollout, scenario redesign, repair, training, ranking, or winner selection
M2457 must define concrete preflight work-item schema, guardrail requirements, and claim boundaries
M2457 must keep labels and hidden/oracle metadata out of actor input
M2457 must select a bounded implementation/audit next route or stop
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun measured policy rollout
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank scenario candidates as winners
do not claim actual success improvement
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the reset/static preflight mapping needed before any execution of materialized protocol rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design-only reset/static preflight mapping; no reset, rollout, policy action, scenario-redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, level3 self-ID, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if concrete preflight work items cannot be defined from M2455 artifacts
stop if labels or hidden/oracle metadata would enter actor input
stop if guardrail requirements cannot be represented
stop if the next route would execute measured rollout without reset/static preflight
fallback_plan: route to implementation if mapping schema is concrete
route to branch synthesis if mapping remains broad
stop for user review if M2455 protocol rows cannot support preflight
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2456 audit routes to reset/static preflight design

allowed_updates: M2457 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: concrete preflight work-item schema is defined
bounded implementation/audit route is selected or route is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2457 designs scenario-quality reset/static preflight mapping and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2457; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2455/M2456 materialized protocol artifacts and audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset/static mapping cannot be designed without contract leakage, synthesize or stop before implementation.
allowed_claims: no actual success improvement, controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns materialized protocol rows into a concrete preflight mapping design
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit reset/static preflight implementation or force synthesis/stop
must_synthesize_if: another design-only route is proposed after M2457 without implementation
the next route would execute measured rollout directly

hypothesis: A design-only reset/static preflight mapping can turn M2455 materialized protocol rows into concrete preflight work items while preserving actor-input and claim boundaries.
success_criteria: the design defines preflight work-item schema and guardrail requirements
the design selects a bounded implementation/audit next route or stops
no reset rollout scenario-redesign execution repair training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2457 resets environment or executes policy action
M2457 executes scenario redesign, repair, or training
M2457 ranks scenario candidates, candidate families, controllers, selected checkpoints, or panel rows as winners
M2457 makes current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign, or training-repair verdict claims
decision_rule: M2457 passes if it writes a concrete reset/static preflight design and selects a bounded implementation/audit route or stops without reset, rollout, scenario redesign execution, repair, training, ranking, winner selection, or verdict claims.
